title: Hoofprints in the Snow
text: Every morning this winter there are tracks in the snow outside the walls. They are cloven, each print the size of a wagon wheel, circling the whole city once in the night before turning back toward the Gate. The hunters will not follow them. The children have started drawing them.

options.label: Send a Scion to follow the tracks and learn how big it is.

outcomes.text: Your Scion follows them to a scar in the hills where the snow has melted in a circle. They come back with a shed horn as long as a lance, and a clear idea of how big it is.
Your Scion follows them too far. At dawn they are found at the bottom of a print, one leg broken under them, babbling about a smell like a forge.

options.label: Lay salt and iron along the whole wall to keep it out.

outcomes.text: The masons line the wall with salt and old nails. After that the tracks keep their distance, and the city sleeps.

options.label: Tell the children to stop drawing them before the fear spreads.

outcomes.text: The children stop drawing the tracks. Instead they draw the thing that made them, and they all draw it the same.
